description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension, part first floor side and rear extension with erection of a front porch extension and detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1921A/pl/01; 1921A/pl/02; 1921A/pl/03; 1921A/pl/04; Location Plan) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials used in construction of the front porch, side extension, rear extension and outbuilding shall only be matching red brick walls, matching clay roof tiles and white UPVC framed double glazed windows/ doors.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side, front or rear walls of the front porch, side extension, rear extension and outbuilding.
Condition : 5 - The proposed first floor side window hereby approved shall be glazed with obscured glass and be fully non-opening.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for the purposes shown in the approved drawings or for other purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 102 Heston Road, TW5 0QP as a single family house, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding.

Condition : 7 - The existing side garage and shed building shall be demolished in full prior to the completion of the rear and side extensions hereby approved, and the land not required for the development of the rear and side extensions shall be landscaped with a natural grass lawn and/ or a planting bed with shrubs, trees, perennials or herbaceous planting within one year of the rear and side extension's completion.
